sn45.28:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you noble right concentration with its supports and its accessories.
sn45.28:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is noble right concentration with its supports and its accessories?
sn45.28:1.5: There are: right view … right mindfulness.
sn45.28:1.6: The one-pointedness of mind equipped with these seven factors is called noble right concentration
sn45.28:1.7: ‘with its supports,’ and also ‘with its accessories.’”
